scenes.title: Baytak in ChatGPT
lines: Two demo accounts (administrator and resident), sample data only.

scenes.caption: Connect Baytak: ChatGPT opens Baytak's own sign-in.
The reviewer signs in with a phone number and a 6-digit code, then allows ChatGPT access.
Connected: a demo administrator and a demo resident. All data is sample data.
Resident: "Do I owe anything for my building this month?"
USD and LBP are kept apart and never added together.
Out of scope: a resident cannot see another apartment's balance.
Administrator: "Who hasn't paid the latest building receipt?"
Unpaid apartments with resident names, and collected against expected. Phone numbers are never shown.
A change asks for permission first: mark apartment 5A as paid.
The change is made and confirmed.
Issuing a receipt starts with a preview. Nothing is issued yet.
Receipts cannot be edited or deleted, so issuing needs an explicit confirmation.
Join requests: approve or reject residents who ask to join the building.
Out of scope: Baytak records fees and does not take payments.
Out of scope: issued receipts cannot be deleted. Nothing was changed.
